source_tests: HumanEval+ (EvalPlus, Liu et al. 2023, Apache-2.0, https://github.com/evalplus/evalplus), HumanEval/62 from https://huggingface.co/datasets/evalplus/humanevalplus
statement: A list of integers holds the coefficients of a polynomial, lowest degree first: the first element is the constant term, the second is the coefficient of x, the third the coefficient of x squared, and so on. Return the coefficients of the derivative of this polynomial in the same form.
